## Context / Problem
Bug tickets carry no record of WHICH detection channel found them (canary, CI, review bot, human audit, user report), so escape-channel trends are unmeasurable. Retroactive classification was rejected (unreliable); capture must happen at creation with zero added user friction.

## Approach
Automated filers set an environment variable (e.g. REBAR_DETECTED_BY=canary|ci|review-bot) that 'rebar create' reads and stamps into the create event; scales to client projects because the filer owns its own env. Human/agent sources may pass an OPTIONAL '--detected-by <source>' flag; absent both, the field is simply unset (never required, never prompted). Document the flag in agent guidance and the bug-creation contract (see canary-hardening sibling).

Validation policy (deterministic, never blocks filing): the value is a free-form token, normalized by strip() + lowercase. Empty or whitespace-only after strip -> treated as unset (field absent from the event). Any non-empty normalized value is stamped verbatim — there is NO enforced enum; the vocabulary canary|ci|review-bot|agent|human-audit|user-report is documented as the recommended set (the metrics lens buckets unknown tokens under 'other'), so new channels never require a code change and create never fails on the value.

Reducer/schema projection (the CREATE reducer whitelists projected keys, so 'tolerated' is not enough): process_create surfaces detected_by additively and present-only, mirroring the existing source_*/creation_channel projection blocks (src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py:112-138), so the field appears in compiled state and 'rebar show' while an event WITHOUT it reduces byte-identically to today. The optional field is declared in the compiled-state schema alongside creation_channel.

## Scope
- src/rebar/_commands/create.py (or the create command module): read env var + optional flag
- src/rebar/reducer/_processors.py: process_create copies detected_by into compiled state present-only (mirroring the source_* block)
- src/rebar/schemas/ticket_state.schema.json: declare the optional detected_by string field
- docs: config/env-vars registry entry + agent guidance line

## Testing
Happy path: env var set -> field present in event, in compiled state, and shown by 'rebar show'. Flag overrides env. Edge: neither set -> field absent from event AND compiled state byte-identical to pre-change reduction (additivity proof). Validation rows: empty string / whitespace-only -> field absent, create succeeds; mixed-case with padding (' Canary ') -> stamped as 'canary'; unknown token ('fuzzer') -> stamped verbatim, create succeeds. Schema round-trip: compiled state with detected_by validates against ticket_state.schema.json.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var stamps detected_by on created tickets; --detected-by flag overrides; absence changes nothing.
- [ ] Normalization is strip+lowercase; empty/whitespace-only is treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim (no enum enforcement); create never fails on the value.
- [ ] process_create projects detected_by present-only into compiled state (mirroring source_*), and an event without the field reduces byte-identically to today; ticket_state.schema.json declares the optional field.
- [ ] Registered in the env-var/docs registry so the drift gate covers it.
- [ ] Tests cover env, flag, absence, precedence, the validation rows (empty, whitespace, mixed-case+padding, unknown token), the reducer projection + byte-identical-absence property, and the schema round-trip.
